segments.contextAfter: Note that background reading isn’t available when an NFC scanning sheet is visible, Wallet or Apple Pay are in use, cameras are in use, the device is in Airplane Mode, and the device is locked after a restart. ![An illustration of a notification banner above the Home screen on iPhone, which offers an opportunity to open a specific app to process NFC tag data detected nearby.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/3e4c92f709b829621f9ea0778cb520cd/nfc-background~dark%402x.png) **Support both background and in-app tag reading.** Your app must still provide an in-app way to scan tags, for people with devices that don’t support background tag reading.
